mutations.name: a rebuild starts over a .next it was not told to resume
kills: rebuildGraph refuses a .next a stopped rebuild left behind, and --resume continues it

mutations.name: chat review verdicts are carried along with GitHub ones
kills: rebuildGraph carries PR forge columns and GitHub review verdicts into the new file, but not chat verdicts

mutations.name: transcript ids are not carried, so the new file renumbers them
kills: rebuildGraph keeps a pruned session's fact at offset 0 on its own transcript id after the rebuild

mutations.name: the swap keeps no backup of the old file
kills: rebuildGraph carries PR forge columns and GitHub review verdicts into the new file, but not chat verdicts

mutations.name: the swap goes ahead when totals differ and refuses only when forced
kills: rebuildGraph turn totals that differ swap nothing and leave .next in place unless forced
